Space.description: A space: a group of channels with its own roles.

app_id.description:
SW13: the App the space belongs to (`[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}`); absent when the space
is not bound. A bound space gets its members only through mgmt calls for that App.

default_channel_ids.description:
Hearth HC6: the channels a joining member lands in (the open join and an add), in the
order MANAGE_SPACE set them; at most 10, absent when none. Guests never see it.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

description.description: Hearth HC4: what the space is for, 1–300 characters; absent when unset.

join_policy.description: Who may join by themself (S10 gap G4). Old payloads without it read as `invite`.

my_perms.description: The viewer's base permissions in the space; absent for non-members (S10 §8).

rules_channel_id.description:
Hearth HC4: the channel holding the space's rules (a public text or announcement
channel of the space); absent when unset. Guests never see it.

slug.description: The slug, unique in the install.

welcome_channel_id.description:
Hearth HC4: where a newcomer starts (a public text or announcement channel of the
space); absent when unset. Guests never see it.

SpaceJoinPolicy.description: Who may join a space by themself (S10 gap G4).

oneOf.description: Any active non-guest member may join.
Members join only when someone adds them (the default).

description: A page of an id-keyed list: `{"items": [...], "has_more": bool}`.

has_more.description: Whether more items exist past this page.

title: Page
